title: Training a muscle just once a week? You may be leaving growth on the table.
hook: Training a muscle just once a week? You may be leaving growth on the table.
caption:
Training a muscle just once a week? You may be leaving growth on the table.

When researchers match the total number of hard sets per week, muscles trained across two or more sessions grow more than the same work crammed into one brutal day. The frequency itself isn't magic — it's that spreading your sets out lets you keep each one hard, instead of grinding through junk reps late in a marathon session.

So the real lever is weekly volume. Frequency is just the tool that lets you actually accumulate that volume with quality.
